Jordan (eng-ml): Heads-up — running into a regression on gptq-3.8-small-quantized vs fp16 baseline. Multilingual QA suite shows accuracy drops and also an uptick in YAML-structured-output parse failures (keys reordered / diacritics lost). Quick snapshot below.

Jordan (eng-ml): ```
Eval: multilingual-qa-suite (en, fr, es)
model: gptq-3.8-small-quantized
batch: 8
seq: 512
seed: 42

metrics:
  EM: baseline 78.3 -> quant 72.1 (-6.2)
  YAML_parse_fail: baseline 0.3% -> quant 4.1%
  rouge-L: baseline 64.2 -> quant 61.1 (-3.1)
  diacritic-loss(fr/es): +12% error on named-entity tokens
```

Priya K.: Is this isolated to GPTQ? Any AWQ/INT8 runs for the same commit/seed?

Jordan (eng-ml): AWQ-int8 run with same seed looked fine (EM -0.4%). So seems GPTQ-specific. Repro command: `python eval.py --model gptq-3.8-small-quant --suite multilingual-qa --batch 8 --seed 42`

Sam T.: Could be kernel/runtime interplay — I noticed ds-prod-5 got runtime 2.14.1 rolled last night which changed some fused-attn flags.

DeployBot: rolled runtime 2.14.1 to ds-prod-5 at 2026-03-18T03:12:02Z by Alex (infra) :package:

Alex (infra): Yup, I rolled 2.14.1 to ds-prod-5 to address a memory leak. The canary used new cudnn flags for fused attention. Rolling a canary rollback now. :wrench:

Maya R.: Also check tokenization path — I remember a fallback to legacy tokenizer lookup in the GPTQ-serving path that omits normalization for certain unicode diacritics. That would explain fr/es entity corruption and YAML key order if tokens are mapped differently.

Jordan (eng-ml): For bisect: quantized weights were produced with `gptq-quantize --group 128 --bits 8` at commit abc123. I'll re-run with `--group 64` and attach the diffs.

EvalBot: nightly-evals/1744999999 reported gptq-3.8-small-quantized YAML_parse_fail=3.9% (alert triggered).

Priya K.: OK assigning: @Sam T. @Maya R. to triage kernel/runtime and tokenizer mismatch; @Jordan (eng-ml) to re-run gptq with group=64 and attach sample outputs. I'll spin up a tiny canary on ds-canary-2 with the fp16 baseline + gptq quant to reproduce. :eyes:
